map.SALT = 0.40×顶部% + 0.24×后部% + 0.18×右侧% +: SALT = 0.40×top% + 0.24×posterior% + 0.18×right% + 0.18×left%. Range 0-100, representing the scalp hair-loss percentage. Treatment response is commonly assessed by the SALT improvement rate.

map.严重度分层：依 SALT 区分轻度（<25%）、中度（25–50%）、重度（>5: Severity stratification: by SALT, mild (<25%), moderate (25-50%), severe (>50%); alopecia totalis/universalis are marked separately.
